comment: It was quick and easy to get through. The questions were in a sensible order and the claim number came through at the end. I'd have liked a clearer heads-up on the tail-light check earlier, and the assistant didn't ask me about the other driver's insurer.
Quick and simple. Sam asked one question at a time, I could answer each in a line, and the claim number came through at the end. Nothing confusing stood out.

The assistant asked one simple question at a time, so I never felt rushed, and it was easy to answer without my policy number. It was clear what was needed and I knew where things stood by the end, with a claim number and a call coming within a business day.

Sam was patient and clear, asked one question at a time, and never made me feel silly for not having my policy number. I got my claim number written down and knew what would happen next, which was a relief.

Pretty quick and it got the claim lodged without me having to dig through stuff with the kids going crazy. The tow being booked straight away was a big relief. Only thing I'd say is it asked for a few things twice and I didn't know the other street name, but it was fine.

Pretty quick and easy once I gave the basics, and they got the tow booked and the claim lodged while I was still on the roadside. Felt a bit repetitive having to say the same details twice, and I wish it had asked about the kids' safety sooner, but overall it did what I needed.

Pretty smooth. Sam asked one clear question at a time, and I could answer each one without digging for details. The only thing I noticed was being asked for my date of birth, which felt like a bit much when my policy number was enough, though Sam did say I didn't have to give it.

Really easy to get through. Sam asked one question at a time, the claim number and next steps were clear, and I was told a consultant would call within a business day. The only thing I'd have liked is a bit more detail on how the door repair gets sorted, but that's a small thing.

Sam was polite and the questions were easy to answer one at a time, and the tow was booked quickly. I was worried about the car and I did not get the tow cost or know if I need to be there when the truck comes, but the consultant will follow up.

Sam was calm and clear, and the claim was lodged quickly with a claim number and a tow booked. The part about excess was hard to understand at first, but Sam explained it with a simple example. I was worried about the car and glad someone was helping me.
Quick and to the point, got the claim lodged and a tow booked without much fuss. Got asked the same things a couple of times though, which annoyed me a bit.
Got the claim lodged without much fuss and the tow was sorted quick. Annoying that it asked me for the policy number again after I'd already given it, but the rest was straightforward.

Sam was patient and made it easy to follow one question at a time, and I didn't feel judged even though I kept apologising and worrying about being in trouble. The claim number and what happens next were clear, which helped me feel calmer about it.

It was really easy to follow, Sam went one step at a time and never made me feel silly for not knowing things like the other car's make. I got my claim number and knew what to do next, which was a relief since I'd never done this before.

Sam was patient and let me go one question at a time, which helped a lot while I was still shaking. I did lose track a few times and had to ask for the claim number again, but it was all written down clearly in the end.

Sam was patient and let me go at my own pace, and the summary before lodging helped me feel sure it was all right. Some of the questions were a bit much when I was still shaking, but the tow being booked straight away was a real relief.

Pretty easy, mate. It asked one thing at a time and I didn't have to dig for anything, though it took me a minute to find the policy number. Didn't love that it kept asking about police and the truck, but I could just say no and it moved on.
Pretty easy, mate. Didn't have to dig much, it asked the right stuff and I got a claim number straight away. Only thing is I had to hunt for the policy number in my emails.

Pretty straightforward. Sam asked clear questions one at a time and I got my claim lodged with a number. It was a bit repetitive, though: I gave my policy details, the car, the date and the location, and then had to confirm them again in the summary.

Quick and straightforward once I had the policy number. The only hiccup was the verification, where my date of birth and mobile didn't match and I had to dig out the policy number myself. After that the questions were clear and it was done in a few minutes.
